subject: Next steps and proposed trial plan — SummitStream demo follow-up
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Ana Morales <ana.morales@summitstream.com>, David Liu <dliu@summitstream.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 08 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps and proposed trial plan — SummitStream demo follow-up

Hi Ana / David —

Thanks again for taking the time today to walk through the demo. I pulled together a concise proposed trial (POC) plan so we can align on goals, timeline, and owners before we kick off. Key points below; full packet attached.

Summary of what we heard on the call
- Primary objective: Automate triage and contextual routing of incoming support tickets to reduce mean time to resolution for Tier 1 by ~30%.
- Important constraints: On-prem data residency for logs, audit trail, and strict rate limits on production inference.
- Evaluation users: 6 support agents + 2 engineers for integration validation.

Proposed trial (3 weeks) — high level
1) Kickoff & env prep (Week 0; 3 business days) — provision trial instance, connect test S3 bucket, and share API keys. Owner: Jonas Weber (SE).
2) Integration & seed data (Week 1) — ingest last 90 days of anonymized tickets, validate mapping to your categories. Owner: SummitStream engineering (David) + Jonas.
3) Evaluation sprint (Week 2) — agents use Redwood inference in parallel with existing workflow; measure precision/recall on triage rules and time saved. Owner: Marissa Cole (Customer Success).
4) Wrap & decision (Week 3) — deliver evaluation report and recommend next steps (scale, quantization profile, or dedicated capacity). Owner: Tessa Morgan (AEs).

Success criteria (proposed — please edit)
- Automated triage accuracy >= 75% on labelled test set.
- Mean time to first action for Tier 1 reduced by >= 20% compared to baseline.
- No PII leakage in inference logs; all persisted data adheres to your retention policy.

Open items for you to confirm
- Which date window works for kickoff? (Proposed: Week of 05/17)
- Who will own procurement & PO (we can loop in our finance ops early)?
- Will your security team need SOC2 artifacts before we move to a private trial? We can attach a short snapshot.

Attachments: SummitStream-POC-Plan-v1.pdf, POC-Success-Criteria.xlsx, SOC2-evidence-summary.txt

Ask: Please reply with: (1) confirmation on the success criteria above (or edits), (2) preferred kickoff week, and (3) procurement contact. Once we have that we will lock dates and send a short mutual action plan.

Thanks —
Tessa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Hi Tessa —

Appreciate the clear plan and doc — this is helpful. A few quick edits from our side: we like the 3-week cadence but would prefer the evaluation sprint be 10 business days to capture weekend volume. Can you update Week 2 -> 10 business days (still within the same overall 3-week window)?

Success criteria adjustments
- Triage accuracy target: 80% (we will provide a labelled sample for validation).
- Time-to-first-action reduction: target 25%.
- Security: our infosec needs a short artifact set (SOC2 snapshot + data handling checklist) before we begin; if those are acceptable we can approve a private trial.

Procurement: PO goes through my colleague David — David, looping you for procurement and any commercial questions.

Kickoff availability: Week of 05/24 would be ideal for us.

Thanks,
Ana
Head of Customer Success | SummitStream
